Δ Experience Excellence with GreenCo: Top DFW Roofing Company Welcome to GreenCo Construction Services – your DFW roofing experts! Since our founding in 1985, we’ve grown into industry leaders in both commercial and residential projects. Serving businesses, churches, families, and more, our success stems from our dedication to excellence and high standards. In Dallas-Fort Worth’s competitive landscape, GreenCo stands out with our commitment to innovation, especially in sustainable solutions. Our partnerships with top manufacturers ensure quality, while our expertise covers everything from TPO and spray foam to steel building erection. Choose GreenCo for clear communication, safety-first solutions, and lasting satisfaction. Our licensed team offers a range of services from inspections and repairs to full-scale projects. data.name: Greenco Commercial Roofing & Construction Services
data.address: 760 E Main St Suite 108, Lewisville, TX 75057

reviews.text: Tad with Greenco has been a great help to me.  I have had other foam insulation roofers work on my commercial property and been difficult to work with.  Tad is extremely responsive and very communicative.  Greenco repair work was done timely and with good quality.
reviews.author: Jo Ann Goin

reviews.text: It was a true pleasure to work with the team from Greenco. From the start, their communication was superb, ensuring that I was always informed about the progress of my roof repair. They did a great job addressing the issues and completing the repairs promptly. What’s even better is that the price was very reasonable. I couldn’t be happier with the service they provided.
reviews.author: Tong Qi

reviews.text:
Greenco did a great job with my roof. I recently hired Greenco for my roof repair, I’m
extremely satisfied with their work. They performed professionally from the beginning to
end. Their team was efficient, skilled, and took great care in ensuring that the work meet
my expectations. They repaired my roof on time with a reasonable price. I highly
recommend Greenco to anyone in need of roofing work in Dallas Fort Worth.
reviews.author: ABC HC

reviews.text: My roof required replacement following the hail storm in May. I received a number of solicitations and proposals for the work, many of which had hidden fees and sub-par warranties for the work to be completed. I fortunately found Tad at Greenco Roofing and construction services . He worked with me to reach alignment on contract terms, provided practical guidance on the roof replacement. He was incredibly responsive and professional in all communications and the work was completed efficiently and on time. I am so pleased with the results and highly recommend Tad and Greenco Roofing.
reviews.author: Song Aimee

reviews.text:
I can’t thank Greenco especially Alex and his team enough for the outstanding job they did on my roof. They
were both knowledgeable and professional, making the entire process smooth and hassle-
free. They were upfront about all costs and provided a clear, itemized estimate from the
beginning, which I greatly appreciated. They’re a trustworthy and reliable choice for any roofing needs.
reviews.author: hao yong

reviews.text: I had my new roof installed a few years ago by Greenco Construction Services. I was extremely happy with their work. They were reliable, professional and neat when ripping up the existing roof. Overall, I would highly recommend this company to anyone looking to improve their home.
reviews.author: Kevin Chen

reviews.text: I recently had an opportunity to work with Greenco and I couldn't be happier with the results. They provided me with a comprehensive assessment of my roofing needs and presented a clear project timeline. The pricing was competitive and reasonable, no hidden costs or surprises. They also assisted me throughout the insurance claim process and maintained a clean and organized worksite. If you're looking for the best roofing company in DFW area, Greenco is the way to go.
reviews.author: Alex Tr

reviews.text: I would like to thank Greenco Construction Services for the great job they did replacing my roof. My project manager was Alex who was very professional, punctual and very knowledgeable. The project was done in a reasonable time and I am very satisfied. I highly recommend this roofing business.
reviews.author: Doris Yang

data.summary: The reviews show strong signs of being inauthentic or heavily curated. The perfect 5.0 rating with 35 reviews, all sampled reviews being 5-star from the same time period, and complete absence of reviews on other platforms is highly suspicious. The language in reviews reads like marketing copy rather than genuine customer feedback.
fake_signals: Reviews posted within same time frame (2 years ago)
Generic, corporate-sounding language across multiple reviews
Lack of specific negative details or constructive feedback
No reviews on other consumer platforms despite 8 years in business
Reviews feel like marketing copy rather than authentic customer experiences

positive_evidence: One review mentions avoiding companies with 'sub-par warranties', implying Greenco's was better

authentic_signals: Some reviews mention specific names (Tad, Alex)
Mention of specific events (hail storm in May)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Perfect 5.0 Google rating with 35 reviews is highly unusual for any contractor, especially with no reviews on other major platforms (Yelp, Angi, Houzz). BBB rating is high but based on accreditation, not customer reviews.
